title: Dormant QSV AMF encoder descriptors
summary: Adds dormant HEVC/H.264/AV1 QSV and AMF descriptors plus descriptor-level flag-generation assertions without routing those codecs through the active descriptor resolver.
reason: Continue the encoder-breadth migration toward descriptor-backed QSV/AMF support while preserving existing encode-argument parity and keeping new hardware backends inactive until capability probing, runtime topology checks, fallback wiring, and real-media validation are ready.
behavior_before: The descriptor catalog covered active HEVC/NVENC and libx265 parity paths plus dormant H.264 and AV1 entries. QSV/AMF choices still fell through the legacy branch, and no descriptor-level QSV/AMF flag shape was pinned.
behavior_after: The descriptor catalog includes dormant HEVC/H.264/AV1 QSV descriptors using preset plus global-quality flags and HEVC/H.264/AV1 AMF descriptors using CQP flags. Unsupported HDR use fails closed for these descriptors. Resolve-MediaEncoderDescriptorForFlags still returns null for QSV/AMF choices, so current pipeline behavior remains unchanged.
manual_validation: bundled ffmpeg -h encoder=hevc_amf/h264_amf/av1_amf - confirmed AMF -rc, -qp_i, -qp_p, and -quality options
bundled ffmpeg -h encoder=hevc_qsv/h264_qsv/av1_qsv - confirmed QSV encoder help is available with preset option
pwsh -NoProfile -File ops\pipeline\tests\Unit\Invoke-EncodeFlagPolicyChecks.ps1 - passed (22 encode snapshots unchanged; dormant QSV/AMF descriptor guards passed)
rollback_plan: Revert MP-CHANGE-2026-0619-043 to remove the dormant QSV/AMF descriptors, QSV/AMF flag generation, focused assertions, generated summaries, and documentation updates. No runtime state or media files are mutated by this change.
notes:
Add dormant QSV/AMF descriptor catalog and direct flag checks without activating resolver selection.
Real-media validation was not run; no QSV/AMF encoder path is activated by this packet.
Refresh generated summaries for the dormant QSV/AMF descriptor slice.
Regenerate project index/dependency graph after QSV/AMF descriptor summary updates.
